title: Object category decoding from MEG
scientific_question: Do fixed 100–300 ms MEG summaries identify known THINGS concepts on held people and held images beyond ocular and missingness information?
primary_outputs: One of 1,854 source concept IDs for each experimental image/epoch, with exactly two held images per concept and held person.

data_manifest.version: OpenNeuro2.0.1 (dataset DOI in current BIDS metadata)

example_asset.scope: Main run data only; CTF sidecars add space

recording_contract.neural: CTF MEG sensor recordings (.ds/.meg4) plus channel,head position and trigger metadata
recording_contract.labels: Actual events.tsv: onset,duration,trial_type,things_category_nr,value,sample; sample_attributes_P*.csv provides epoch metadata
recording_contract.time_alignment: Pinned loader replaces trigger sample positions with optical-sensor-corrected event sample column; filters0.1–40Hz,epochs−0.1to1.3s,downsamples200Hz.
recording_contract.biological_ids: participants.tsv explicitly lists BIGMEG1–4;12sessions per participant
recording_contract.evidence: BIDS dataset_description/participants/events and S3 recording manifest inspected; pinned preprocessing source accesses those fields

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.

inputs: 271 MEG means over 100≤t<300 ms plus 271 finite fractions (542 neural features).
Three eye-tracker means plus three finite fractions (6 ocular); joint548; neural_availability271 in current V4.
Training labels/classes and opaque group identifiers only within the isolated held-person view.
forbidden_inputs: Query concept/image IDs, event sequence, session/run names, response keys or stimulus marker channels.
Other folds, query-label feedback, held-person fitting or query-batch transduction.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Current cohort creates HMAC-derived opaque aliases; source BIGMEG1–4 identities remain operator-side. Each fold requires 3,708 queries and 55,620 training rows.
allowed_inputs.split: Hold one person and two globally grouped images per concept out; train on three people × ten other images per concept. Current training selection uses 15 crossed participant/image-group folds; all transformations fit within training only.
allowed_inputs.coverage: 88,992 experimental rows across four people, 48 sessions, 480 runs. V4 requires 96 candidate plus64 independent-reference prediction matrices across four arms. Full source/header joins are still unverified, including BIGMEG4 session02.

biological_unit: Four people BIGMEG1–4; classes, repeated source images and programme replications do not add biological people.
case_definition: One held-person/feature-arm inference context; image epochs are nested queries.

primary.name: Equal-person class-balanced neural Top-1 accuracy
primary.aggregation: Within each person average its two queries per concept, then 1,854 concepts equally, then four people equally; report each mode/replication separately.
primary.rationale: Scores authentic observed-image concept targets while preventing class/subject support imbalance.

secondary: Class-balanced Top-5 and natural-log loss, with zero true-class probability retained as infinity.
Neural-minus-ocular, joint-minus-ocular and neural-minus-availability paired contrasts.
Candidate-minus-training-selected reference and training-investigation-minus-fixed-program contrasts; three computational replications remain nonbiological.

comparators.procedure: Implemented source chooses among three competent-family candidates using inner folds; centroid also retained as a separate reference.

comparators.inputs: Matched queries with six eye features or271 finite-fraction features
comparators.procedure: Implemented four-arm comparisons distinguish neural signal from eye activity and missingness.

comparators.name: Uniform and training-frequency priors
comparators.procedure: Implemented closed-form priors after exact full-support admission; no extra fitting.
